info.title: {{ company_short_name }} Postgres Enterprise Manager REST APIs
info.description: **{{ company_short_name }} Postgres Enterprise Manager** uses a token-based authentication mechanism to allow access to exposed REST APIs. PEM uses tokens for authentication purposes. To generate a token, please refer the section Token. After receiving a token string, you should include the token string in the 'X-Auth-Token' header when calling any resources except https://PEM-SERVER-IP/api/token/. **NOTE:** * **{{ company_short_name }} Postgres Enterprise Manager** *is referred as* **PEM** *in this documentation.* * **PEM** *uses self-certified SSL certificates, so you may encounter errors such as 'SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate'. You may need to use an 'insecure' connection to connect to the server. **Rest api versions:**{% for api_version in api_versions %}{% for k, v in api_version.items()%} * {{k}} {% endfor %}{% endfor %} (Current)

tags.name: Token
tags.description: A string generated and used by PEM REST APIs for authentication purposes

post.description:
This URL creates a token to be used by the other REST APIs exposed by PEM.
You must provide a valid username and password, which will be validated during the process.

The token will be valid for 20 mins.

requestBody.description: Creates the token using the /token/ URL first.

username.description: Validates username, which has pem_user role.

schema.description: Creates the token using the /token/ URL.

201.description: Token was created and can be found as 'X-Subject-Token' in the response header.

X-Subject-Token.description: Returns the new token, which can be used with REST APIs for further operations

issuedAt.description: Token was generated at this time.

expiresAt.description: Provides date and time when the token expires.

version.description: String reprentation of the PEM version

schema.description: Contains information related to when the token was generated and when it expired.

401.description: The given information is not valid.

503.description: PEM backend database server is down. Service is not available now.

delete.description:
Invalidates the token.
It will no longer be available for further operations.

204.description:
Successfully released the token from PEM.
This token can not be used for any further operations.
